sv.title: Dömer ut börsstudsen: ”Fredag blir riktiga testet”
sv.summary: Europabörserna rusade medan Wall Street-handlarna firade Thanksgiving. Men bedömare ifrågasätter om torsdagens uppstuds håller när USA öppnar i morgon. ”Fredagen blir det riktiga testet”, säger Panmure Liberum-strategen Joachim Klement till Bloomberg.

en.title: Dismisses the market bounce: "Friday will be the real test"
en.summary: European stock markets surged while Wall Street traders celebrated Thanksgiving. But analysts question whether Thursday's bounce will hold when the US opens tomorrow. "Friday will be the real test," says Panmure Liberum strategist Joachim Klement to Bloomberg.
